name: Marshena Debtbinder
languages: Common and any three languages, Sylvan

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Marshena makes three Arcane Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Withering Bolt or (B) Spellcasting to cast *Ray of Sickness*.

Actions.name: Arcane Burst
Actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
Marshena casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** *Detect Magic*, *Light*, *Mage Armor*, *Mage Hand*, *Prestidigitation*
- **2/Day Each:** *Fireball*, *Invisibility*
- **1/Day Each:** *Cone of Cold*, *Fly*

Actions.name: Withering Bolt
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 14, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage.
Actions.expresses: curses meant to take actions away

Reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
Reactions.text: Marshena casts *Counterspell* or *Shield* in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Bonus Actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: Marshena casts *Misty Step*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

lore: A hedge-hexer who drowned her debts in the marsh and stayed to collect on the trespassers who follow, she hoards every curse she has laid like a ledger of small, repayable cruelties.

generation.userConcept: a marsh witch who curses trespassers, cr 7
generation.cite: composition after Spirit Naga (CR 8) — the or-form bite-and-ray with the debuff single
